feeds.title: Cyclist Magazine
feeds.description: Dedicated solely to road cycling, Cyclist is a premium magazine for Australia's cycling enthusiasts. Cyclist is for anyone that loves cycling and loves bikes. From the ultimate rides at home and abroad to the latest gear and interviews with the cycling world's biggest names.

feeds.title: Women Who Cycle
feeds.description: Covers articles on bike clothing, maintenance, travel, accidents, tours and more. Nicola Rutzou is a Sydney-based cyclist who is passionate about cycling and encouraging other women to join.

feeds.title: Bicycling Australia
feeds.description: Bicycling Australia Magazine is a magazine that focuses on road cycling and racing in Australia. It was founded in 1986 and provides readers with information on the latest gear, training tips, and insights into the cycling community in Australia.

feeds.title: Ride Media
feeds.description: RIDE Media is an independently owned media company in Australia that specializes in coverage of cycling. RIDE Media reviews racing from around the globe, giving insight into the pro peloton with exclusive interviews and features, beautiful photography, and expert analysis, reporting, and opinion from some of the world's most knowledgeable, respected cycling commentators and pro cyclists.

feeds.title: Tour De Vines Blog
feeds.description: Catch up on all things cycling tours, bikes, active holidays, and wine from around the world. Tour de Vines is Australia's No 1 cycling tour operator. If you're looking for a unique cycling tour, in an amazing location, that includes local and passionate food and wine experiences, Tour de Vines is for you. We aim to make your cycling tour not only brilliant, fun, and amazing, but easy for you.

feeds.title: WestCycle Blog
feeds.description: WestCycle is Western Australia's Peak Body for cycling and a representative voice for all bike riders. Our dedicated team strives to develop, promote, and enact positive changes state-wide. The WestCycle Blog gives an insight into what is happening in the WestCycle office and the cycling community as a whole.

feeds.title: South Perth Rouleurs Blog
feeds.description: South Perth Rouleurs Blog contains all the information about the club. South Perth Rouleurs is the official website of the South Perth cycle club. The club offers bicycle training rides and caters to all skill levels, from novice to A-grade racers. We also aim to develop pathways for those pursuing an interest in racing, with particular emphasis on developing women's racing.

feeds.title: Canberra Cycling Club News
feeds.description: Get news and information regarding cycling and bike racing in the ACT region. The Canberra Cycling Club (CCC) is one of the oldest and largest cycling clubs in Australia and is affiliated with AusCycling ACT. The CCC is proud of its success over the years and is represented on the international stage by several riders, including Jay Vine, Nathan Hart, Chloe Hosking, and Gracie Elvin amongst others.

feeds.title: Tony's Tasmanian Cycling Blog
feeds.description: Read featured articles including; The Trailer Shakedown Trip, A few Days in Devonport, Going up 'The Grunter' and more. This blog is about day rides, overnight camp rides, and the occasional longer trips in Tasmania by Tony.

feeds.title: CyclingAbout.com
feeds.description: CyclingAbout is the most popular bike travel websites, creating resources for bicycle touring, bikepacking and other bike adventures. The website can assist you with technical resources, inspiration, reviews, videos, and more.

feeds.title: The Climbing Cyclist
feeds.description: Hi, my name's Matt de Neef and I'm the founder and publisher of The Climbing Cyclist. The Climbing Cyclist contains detailed information about many terrific cycling climbs in Victoria, Australia, including start-to-finish line photos and stories.

feeds.title: CycleSydney
feeds.description: On this site, you will find information on recreational bike trails from all over Australia. Discover videos, photos, stories, and maps on BikeTrail.Blog.

feeds.title: The Uncool Cycling Club Blog
feeds.description: Read about the latest adventures of the Uncool Cycling Club on our blog page. The Uncool Cycling Club aims to help you get out of the house and onto your bicycle by inspiring you with interesting rides that are achievable for the intermediate or average rider.

feeds.title: Adventure Cycling Victoria Blog
feeds.description: Get ride news and updates from Adventure Cycling Victoria Blog. Adventure Cycling Victoria started by Peter Foot is a guide to the best backpacking and bicycle-touring routes in Victoria, Australia.

feeds.title: bikes.com.au Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog topics including; the best way to teach your kids how to ride, 8 must-have mountain bike accessories, the best bike trails In Melbourne, and many more. Welcome to Melbourne bikes.com.au, home to the biggest range of electric bikes, mountain bikes, road bikes, gravel bikes, commuter bikes, and kids' bikes and accessories in Melbourne.

feeds.title: ALÉ Australia Blog
feeds.description: Explore topics including; PRR green road, the benefits of nutrition for your performance, and many more. Ale Cycling is a leading cycling apparel manufacturer. They focus on innovation in production, materials, and design to ensure the functionality, comfort, and performance our athletes desire.

feeds.title: Cycology Blog
feeds.description: Cycology is an Australian Cycling brand based around original cycling art created by a cyclist for cyclists. Check out our large range of high-quality cycling apparel and accessories in original & unique designs at Cycology USA.

feeds.title: Cycle Down Under Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Cycle Down Under website. Cycle Down Under provides recreational cyclists with a comprehensive list of cycling events, a calendar that allows you to search for a ride, a monthly newsletter to keep you up-to-date with new rides, closing dates for early birds & registrations, and much more.

feeds.title: Flow Mountain Bike
feeds.description: Flow Mountain Bike is the first and last name in mountain biking throughout Australia and New Zealand. Rider owned and run, Flow Mountain Bike is the ultimate resource to keep you informed and inspired. Head to Flow Mountain Bike blog for all the latest mountain bike news, new products, race coverage and more. We keep you informed through video bike reviews and product tests, maintenance advice, riding tips and skills, interviews and tonnes of great web-only features. Enjoy- feel the Flow!

feeds.title: Australian Mountain Bike Magazine
feeds.description: Australian Mountain Bike magazine blog is Australia's oldest and most respected mountain bike magazine, inspiring and informing riders around the country in print and online. We inform and inspire Australian mountain bikers about everything that makes our sport what it is.

feeds.title: Off Course News
feeds.description: Commuter Cycles is a bike workshop dedicated to everyday cyclists. Fixing bikes is what we do. If you love your bike, and ride it to get from A to B, Commuter Cycles is your bike shop.

feeds.title: Curve Cycling
feeds.description: Steve founded Curve Cycling back in 2012, pursuing an opportunity to offer fellow riders high-spec products without excessive marketing noise. Forming the Curve Dream Team around the early vision was key to the brand's progression and innovation. Check out blogs to know more about our products.

feeds.title: Bicycles Network Australia
feeds.description: The Top Australian Cycling Portal. Bicycles Network Australia - For Australian Cyclists. Active Online Cycling Community, Bike news and review and all Aussie Bicycle shops, cycling clubs, bicycling organisations and international bike brands, manufacturers, importers and distributers.

feeds.title: Bike Chaser News
feeds.description: Articles on people & community, pedal performance, cycling science, reviews and more. Bike Chaser exists to support and foster the growth of the Australian cycling community (Bike Shops and Cyclists) by providing a platform for cyclists to connect and trade.

feeds.title: BikeSportz Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest trends, ideas, and tips from our Product Blog. BikeSportz is one of the leading suppliers of premium cycling parts and accessories in Australia. Bikesportz and its team of passionate bicycle industry professionals are determined to provide the best products, services, investments, and partnerships to Australia's broadening base of bicycle industry retailers & customers.

feeds.title: BBB Cycling Australia Blog
feeds.description: BBB Cycling Australia is an online bicycle retailer. It provides access to beautiful and innovative bicycle products and accessories that enhance your cycling experience. Our passion at BBB Cycling Australia is to support cyclists and retailers who make their riding possible. Find road trip stories, bicycle cleaning tips, and more.

feeds.title: Bicycles Network Australia
feeds.description: Bicycles Network Australia was launched as a free online information resource for Australian cyclists. It includes a comprehensive cycling directory, hosts a popular cycling forum with over 29,000 members, and publishes cycling news, articles, and reviews.
